page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Centred lines in large capitals and smaller roman type, with show-through from the reverse side. Woodcut ornament and a stamp below the text.

main_text.l: D. OTTHONIS S. M. Hallio Lauda

page.notes: The title page is heavily faded and shows mirrored show-through from the reverse side, so most of the lines in the middle (the subtitle, the dedication lines, and the lines naming the printer and patron) are only partly legible and are marked illegible rather than guessed. The printer line near the foot is blurred; the words "impensis" and the rest are uncertain. A woodcut ornament and an ink stamp lie between the author's name and the imprint; these are not transcribed.
